💡 This work uniquely correlates operando XCT and XRD with stack pressure monitoring to link particle-level morphology, lattice strain, and interfacial degradation in sulfide-based ASSBs. Small | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in programming closed pores during precursor assembly via alcohol-regulated interfacial assembly, rather than post-carbonization reconstruction, enabling control over pore accessibility and interfacial chemistry. This yields hard carbon with abundant closed ultramicropores, thin inorganic-rich SEI, outstanding rate capability (119 mAh g⁻¹ at 10 A g⁻¹), 6000-cycle stability, and excellent low-temperature performance, establishing a general strategy for fast-charging, long-life sodium-ion batteries.

item.title: In Situ Assembled Carboxyl‐Functionalized Hexaazatrinaphthylene Enables Accelerated Li + Transport and Localized FEC Enrichment in Silicon Anodes
item.description:
این مقاله با مهندسی میان‌سطح مولکولی مبتنی بر HATNTA در آند Si، غنی‌سازی موضعی FEC و تشکیل SEI غنی از LiF را ممکن کرده و انتقال Li+ و پایداری چرخه را بهبود می‌دهد.
Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using carboxyl-functionalized HATNTA, a π-conjugated HATN derivative, as a molecular interphase engineer for Si anodes. Its polar C═N sites coordinate Li⁺ while carboxyl groups locally enrich FEC, steering formation of a LiF-rich SEI. This suppresses electrolyte decomposition and electrode degradation, yielding high ICE (92.56%), excellent rate capability, and stable cycling—offering a molecular design strategy for stabilizing Si anodes.
🏷 silicon anode · solid electrolyte interphase · HATNTA · LiF-rich SEI · lithium-ion battery
